Executive Order
It is hereby ordered , under authority contained in Section 5 of the Act of
February 8, 1887 (24 Stat . 389 ), that the trust period on allotments made to the
Indians of the Kiowa, Comanche , Apache and Wichita Reservation in Oklahoma,
which trust expires during the calendar year , 1926, be, and is hereby extended for
a period of ten years , with the following exceptions :

619097Executive Order 424 — Authorizing Appointment of Robert Lee Gray as Assistant Messenger in Department of Justice Without Examination1906President of the United States

Robert Lee Gray may be appointed as assistant messenger in the Department of Justice without examination under the civil-service rules.

Theodore Roosevelt.

The White House,

March 1, 1906.
